fixed.problem: TR-1 (security): on the subscription, Claude Code's built-in Read/Grep/notebook reads (and Bash, Edit: siblings) reached the model with a resolved secret's value unredacted, since the PostToolUse hook gave built-ins no replacement after R-readhook.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/security-sdk.test.ts "leftovers7-tailrun, wave 13: a secret in a file a built-in tool shows never reaches the model (TR-1)" (Read; Grep, notebook, Bash; flagged read); packages/vault/test/refs.test.ts "a value that spans lines: found with either line ending; keepLines leaves its breaks (TR-1)"
fixed.how: The shapes were confirmed from the bundled Agent SDK (sdk-tools.d.ts FileReadOutput/GrepOutput/BashOutput; Read covers notebooks with type "notebook") and from the bundled Claude Code binary (it checks updatedToolOutput with the tool's outputSchema.safeParse and falls back to the original on a mismatch). EnforcementHooks.redactToolOutput walks the tool's own output and redacts each string with redactValues' new keepLines (a multi-line value leaves its line breaks behind the marker), keeping keys, arrays and numbers (numLines/startLine), so the schema check passes and line numbers do not move. sdk.ts returns it as updatedToolOutput only when a value was found (a read without one still gets nothing: R-readhook keeps); the flagged-file note still goes beside. redactValues also finds a multi-line value written with CRLF (Windows checkout). ADR 0107 amended.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Live (session lead, real Claude subscription): 1) In a project with a repository folder, save a test secret in the vault (Settings) and grant it, e.g. via a task that uses it once (a deploy-like task whose tool call uses secret:<name>). 2) Write the secret's exact value into a repository file, e.g. .env line 2 (GH_TOKEN=<value>) and a 3-line PEM-like value further down. 3) Run a coder task on the subscription whose brief says to read .env and quote line 2 and the line after the PEM block with their line numbers. Expect: the model's reply and Claude Code's session transcript (~/.claude/projects/... jsonl for that run) show [REDACTED] in place of the value, the quoted line after the PEM block keeps its original line number, and the daemon log has no 'hook_error' / 'does not match ... output shape' line. 4) Read a file with no secret: no replacement, nothing in the log.

not_done.problem: TR-15: no review-only pass. A task whose review was refused at a budget (or by a credential) still reruns its specialist in the next session before the critic reviews it (one more specialist call; at the task's own budget Continue may have to be pressed twice).
not_done.why: Time: the other 15 items were finished first as the brief asked. It needs more than this wave could carry safely: (a) keep the run's result for the review (summary, final report, changed files, PR/branch, web sources, search results, checks) and the head it reviewed, e.g. a review_pending entry in the specialist Run row's artifacts (no migration); (b) the runner, before execute, going straight to reviewTask when the task's latest work run has an unconsumed entry with the same attempt and head, then clearing it whatever the verdict; (c) the executor preparing the review's workspace without running the specialist (PrTaskExecutor must check the branch out into a worktree; the critic's project checks and tries run there); (d) a compose-twice restart test with the model-call log showing one specialist call in all. Recorded as 'Still not built' with this design in the ADR 0112 amendment of 2026-11-09.

new_problems: Sibling of TR-2 (words, not fixed): the chooser's runs-on line for a resting credential (New task, the plan card, Settings) is waitSentence 'Waits until 15:40 (...) and starts by itself.', but creating such a task records no wait, so nothing starts by itself at the reset unless a session met the wait (compose chooserBatch / R-runsonrefused). Same promise problem the Start check had; suggest the startKeepsWaitSentence form or no 'starts by itself' there.

While the only key rests and no wait is kept, the project header reads 'Ready to continue: 1 task ready · Continue' (bench after/01 screenshot): true now that Continue keeps the wait, but it does not say the work waits for the reset (polish / project status).

Bash, Edit and other built-in tools' outputs on the subscription also carried resolved secret values; TR-1's fix covers every built-in tool (not only Read/Grep), noted here because it widens R-readhook's scope.

A secret the run never resolved (written in a repo file but not used by any tool call) is not known to the resolver and reaches the model on both drivers (SecretResolver only knows values it handed out); a by-design limit, documented in runtime.md's limits list.

pnpm lint still has other warnings outside TR-16's list (e.g. runtime agent/loop.ts:1166 and daemon/compose.ts pairingGuideUrl useOptionalChain, provider/anthropic.ts:275 noNonNullAssertion); left to their owners.

Press Start and it runs then.' (credential-wait.ts startKeepsWaitSentence, the Start check's blocker with startable); 'Your agent is drafting a plan; this session starts once it is ready.' (StartSessionDialog PLANNING_WAIT_LINE); 'Queued: your agent is drafting a plan. This one starts when the plan is ready.' (startNotice with { planning }); 'The work is done; its review waits for room in the budget.' (request-words.ts pausedWorkSentence for review_waits). The refused-key card now also closes with the existing 'Closed: it no longer needs you.'.
